post_route_points_check.name: post_route_points_check
post_route_points_check.value:
"post_route_points"."position" BETWEEN 0 AND 19 AND
    "post_route_points"."lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "post_route_points"."lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND
    ("post_route_points"."label" IS NULL OR length("post_route_points"."label") BETWEEN 1 AND 60)

posts_type_fields_check.name: posts_type_fields_check
posts_type_fields_check.value:
("posts"."type" = 'simple' AND "posts"."source" IS NULL AND "posts"."lat" IS NULL AND "posts"."lng" IS NULL) OR
    ("posts"."type" = 'translate' AND "posts"."source" IS NOT NULL AND "posts"."lat" IS NULL AND "posts"."lng" IS NULL) OR
    ("posts"."type" = 'travel' AND "posts"."source" IS NULL AND "posts"."lat" IS NOT NULL AND "posts"."lng" IS NOT NULL)

posts_travel_days_check.name: posts_travel_days_check
posts_travel_days_check.value: "posts"."travel_days" IS NULL OR ("posts"."type" = 'travel' AND "posts"."travel_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 365)

posts_lead_check.name: posts_lead_check
posts_lead_check.value: "posts"."lead" IS NULL OR length("posts"."lead") BETWEEN 20 AND 200

users_name_genitive_check.name: users_name_genitive_check
users_name_genitive_check.value: "users"."name_genitive" IS NULL OR length("users"."name_genitive") BETWEEN 1 AND 40
